# Easner

> Cross-border banking, payouts, collections, cards, and stablecoin rails for businesses, individuals, and partners. Easner is a fintech company, not a bank.

## Overview

- [Home](https://www.easner.com/): Stablecoin-powered accounts, payouts, collections, cards, and partner programs
- [Contact](https://www.easner.com/contact): Sales, demos, and partnership inquiries

## Products

- [Business Banking](https://www.easner.com/business): Multi-currency accounts, payouts, invoicing, and team access for cross-border operators
- [Personal Banking](https://www.easner.com/personal): Global send and receive via Easner Mobile for freelancers, diaspora, and remote workers
- [Stablecoin](https://www.easner.com/stablecoin): Receive, send, Terminal, and QR Pay with familiar banking screens
- [Invoicing](https://www.easner.com/invoicing): Global B2B invoicing with bank or stablecoin pay-in
- [Cards](https://www.easner.com/cards): Virtual and physical cards with spend controls on one ledger

## Programs

- [Partners](https://www.easner.com/partners): White-label OTC and remittance programs via the Agency Model
- [Developers](https://www.easner.com/developers): Embedded payments API for KYC/KYB, accounts, pay-in, payouts, and webhooks

## Legal

- [Terms of Service](https://www.easner.com/terms): Terms for Easner Mobile, Easner Business, Easner for Partners, and related services
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.easner.com/privacy): How Easner collects, uses, shares, and protects information
- [KYC/KYB and AML Policy](https://www.easner.com/compliance): Verification, screening, and transaction controls

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.easner.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of public pages
